title: GHS-SMOD R2023A: the degree of urbanisation of the Earth in 2025, on the WGS 84 grid of 30 arc-seconds
provider: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC), Global Human Settlement Layer; GHS_SMOD_E2025_GLOBE_R2023A_4326_30ss, version 2.0
credit: GHS-SMOD R2023A, European Commission JRC, CC BY 4.0
format: GeoTIFF of one band of classes of the Degree of Urbanisation stage I: 30 urban centre, 23 dense urban cluster, 22 semi-dense urban cluster, 21 suburban or peri-urban, 13 rural cluster, 12 low density rural, 11 very low density rural, 10 water.
coverage: The whole Earth at the epoch 2025; epochs 1975-2030 every five years are in the same release.
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the JRC's reuse policy). Changes made here: windows about the workbench's cities, classes recoded to eight steps.
citation: Schiavina, M., Melchiorri, M. and Pesaresi, M. (2023), GHS-SMOD R2023A: GHS settlement layers, application of the Degree of Urbanisation methodology (stage I) to GHS-POP R2023A and GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, multitemporal (1975-2030), European Commission, Joint Research Centre, doi:10.2905/A0DF7A6F-49DE-46EA-9BDE-563437A6E2BA.
